title: Kulemak's Invitation: Abyssal Drop, Well of Souls and Black Cathedral Access
summary: Kulemak's Invitation is the Abyss pinnacle key that drops 100% from the Abyssal Commanders Tasgul or Vandroth in level 79+ Abyssal Depths. Carry it to the Well of Souls to enter the Black Cathedral and fight the Vessel of Kulemak.
description: A source-linked reference for Kulemak's Invitation in Path of Exile 2: where it drops, how the Well of Souls 'Jump In' prompt works, the 0.5 map-owner allocation, and what the Vessel of Kulemak encounter rewards.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Kulemak's Invitation — the Abyss pinnacle key item that drops from Abyssal Commanders and opens the Well of Souls to the Black Cathedral

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Kulemak's Invitation is a one-time Abyss pinnacle key. It drops 100% from the Abyssal Commanders Tasgul (Swallower of Light) or Vandroth (Blackblooded Enslaver) in level 79+ Abyssal Depths. Carry it to the Well of Souls, use the 'Jump In' prompt, and it is consumed to send you to the Black Cathedral to fight the Vessel of Kulemak.
calloutDetail: In a party, the 0.5 allocation rule assigns the drop to the Map owner; the item itself can still be obtained from other players via the currency exchange.
The invitation is consumed the moment you enter — there is no refund if you die, leave, or fail the gauntlet.

answers.label: Use for
text: Fighting the Vessel of Kulemak pinnacle boss, building the Grip of Kulemak ring, and (as a Lich) unlocking the Abyssal Lich sub-ascendancy.

answers.label: Where
text: The Well of Souls — interact at the cliff edge; not the map screen and not the Act 2 campaign well.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Entering on an undergeared build, or resetting the wrong instance hoping the button reappears — the prompt only shows with the item in your inventory at the correct Well of Souls.

facts.label: Source
note: 100% drop from Tasgul or Vandroth in level 79+ Abyssal Depths.

facts.label: Type
note: One-time consumable; consumed on entry to the Black Cathedral.

facts.label: Use
note: 'Jump In' prompt at the cliff edge; not usable from the map device.

facts.label: Boss
note: Respawning pinnacle boss; up to 4 revives to build the Grip of Kulemak.

facts.label: Patch 0.5
note: In parties the drop goes to the map owner; still tradeable on the currency exchange.

sections.title: How to get Kulemak's Invitation
intro: Kulemak's Invitation only drops from two specific Abyssal Commanders. The drop itself is guaranteed; the real bottleneck is forcing the Commander to spawn.

routes.label: Abyssal Commanders (natural)
body: Tasgul, Swallower of Light and Vandroth, Blackblooded Enslaver appear in the Abyssal Depths reached from an Abyss fissure in level 79+ maps. Neither Commander is guaranteed to spawn, so you may clear many Abyss encounters before one appears.

routes.label: Desecrated Waystone (forced)
body: A Desecrated Waystone guarantees an Abyssal boss appears in that map, turning the random spawn into a reliable run. This is the single biggest efficiency gain for farming invitations.

routes.label: Atlas + Abyss nodes
body: Allocate Abyss frequency, Abyssal Depths depth, and 'Abysses lead to an Abyssal Boss' nodes on your Atlas passive tree, and run level 79+ maps so the Depths are on-level.

routes.label: Currency Exchange / trade
body: Buy an invitation from other players (speak to Ange). Prices float through the league, so price-check live before buying. The invitation is tradeable.

steps.label: Hold the invitation
body: Keep Kulemak's Invitation in your main inventory. Community reports note it sits in the Fragment tab, not the Abyss tab — check the right stash tab before assuming it vanished.

steps.label: Travel to the Well of Souls
body: Go to the correct Endgame Well of Souls (the location tied to the current Abyss endgame), not the ordinary Act 2 campaign well. Stand at the cliff edge.

steps.label: Use 'Jump In'
body: With the item in your inventory a new prompt appears beside the Desecrate option. Interact with it — the invitation is consumed and you drop into the Black Cathedral.

steps.label: Open the gate and fight
body: Present the invitation at the gate below, enter the arena, and defeat the Vessel of Kulemak. After the first kill you may 'Take the Finger' to leave with the ring, or revive the boss up to three more times to stack Desecrated modifiers.

steps.label: Return the Finger (optional)
body: On the fourth clear, choose 'Return the Finger' to fight the Vessel at full strength. Winning as a Lich unlocks the Abyssal Lich sub-ascendancy.

sections.title: Where the invitation works
note: Kulemak's Invitation only works at the correct Well of Souls with the item in your inventory. It is not used from the map device and not at the Act 2 campaign well.

items.label: Build can clear it
checks: Confirm your build can survive the Vessel of Kulemak gauntlet before spending the invitation.
items.why: The invitation is consumed on entry with no refund on death or failure.
items.fix: Farm a cheaper attempt or buy one only when prepared.

items.label: Item in inventory
checks: Verify Kulemak's Invitation is in your main inventory / Fragment tab.
items.why: The 'Jump In' prompt only appears while the item is held.
items.fix: Move it out of the wrong stash tab.

items.label: Correct Well of Souls
checks: Travel to the Endgame Well of Souls, not the Act 2 campaign well.
items.why: The prompt does not appear at the wrong well.
items.fix: Use the current Abyss endgame waypoint.

items.label: Map owner (party)
checks: If in a party, the drop is allocated to the Map owner.
items.why: In 0.5 the invitation is assigned to the map owner on drop.
items.fix: Have the map owner open it, or trade for your own.

sections.title: Which builds use it
intro: Kulemak's Invitation is build-agnostic — any character that can clear the Vessel of Kulemak can use it. The reward path differs by ascendancy.

builds.title: Lich (Abyssal Lich)
builds.description: Return the Finger at full strength to unlock the Abyssal Lich sub-ascendancy and gain the Abyssal Apparition skill.

builds.title: Ring crafters
builds.description: Revive the Vessel up to 3 times to stack Desecrated modifiers onto the Grip of Kulemak before taking it.

builds.title: Currency farmers
builds.description: Force Abyssal Commander spawns with Desecrated Waystones and sell Ancient Bones / unique drops; the entry cost is the invitation.

entries.question: I have the invitation in my bag but the Well has no option to use it.
summary: Players report the 'Jump In' prompt missing even with the item in inventory.
editorialAnalysis: The prompt only appears at the correct Well of Souls with the invitation held. Common causes: wrong (Act 2 campaign) well, item in the wrong stash tab, or the instance was reset. In 0.5 the drop is also allocated to the Map owner in parties.
officialAnswer: Travel to the Endgame Well of Souls with the invitation in your inventory; the 'Jump In' prompt appears at the cliff edge.

entries.question: I farmed Depths for ages and never saw the Commander drop one.
summary: Players conflate the guaranteed drop with the random spawn.
editorialAnalysis: The drop is 100% once a Commander is defeated, but the Commander itself is not guaranteed to spawn in any given Abyssal Depths. Use a Desecrated Waystone to force the spawn.
officialAnswer: Defeat Tasgul or Vandroth in level 79+ Abyssal Depths; the invitation is a guaranteed drop. Force the spawn with a Desecrated Waystone.

entries.question: Is the invitation worth buying versus farming?
summary: Community guides price-check the invitation weekly; values float.
editorialAnalysis: Because the drop is gated by spawn RNG, buying is a legitimate shortcut. Treat all prices as league-variable and verify live on the trade site.
officialAnswer: The invitation is tradeable; buy or farm depending on your time and currency.
